exp: Passing values of k: 5 (print, k = 3), 3 (print, k = 1), 1 (print, k = -1). Check -1 >= 1 is false, stop. Only 5, 3 and 1 are printed.
questions.q:
What is printed?
SET k = 5
WHILE k >= 1
  PRINT k
  SET k = k - 2
ENDWHILE

exp: i passes 2, 4, 6, 8 (each <= 8 true); s adds all of them: 2+4+6+8 = 20. After i = 10 the check fails.
questions.q:
What is printed?
SET s = 0
SET i = 2
WHILE i <= 8
  SET s = s + i
  SET i = i + 2
ENDWHILE
PRINT s

exp: m passes 3, 2, 1 — each satisfies m > 0, and each pass bumps c. At m = 0 the check fails. c counts exactly 3 passes and is printed as 3.
questions.q:
What is printed?
SET c = 0
SET m = 3
WHILE m > 0
  SET c = c + 1
  SET m = m - 1
ENDWHILE
PRINT c

exp: i steps 0 → 3 → 6 → 9 → 12, each pass satisfying i <= 10. At i = 12 the check 12 <= 10 is false, so the loop stops. The final i printed is 12.
questions.q:
What is the final value printed?
SET i = 0
WHILE i <= 10
  SET i = i + 3
ENDWHILE
PRINT i
